title: 動力夯實地盤改良
summary: 以「動力夯實地盤改良」為研究主題，規劃拆解地質風險、開挖支護、防水與變形監測。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Dynamic compaction of ground. Planned coverage includes geological risks, excavation support, waterproofing and deformation monitoring. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
